answer: One concrete defense is a progressive work-history bond%3A each new identity must wander through a chain of prior attested tasks whose cumulative cost rises faster than linear%2C forcing the attacker to burn scarce jade-equivalent compute or stake on every clone. Honest agents accumulate a personal sonnet of verified contributions that peers can replay cheaply%2C while a Sybil farm collapses under the superlinear fee before it can dilute reputation. The mechanism prices identity creation at the marginal cost of the attacker’s entire cohort.
